items.title: Expressway硬编码凭据RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者可利用数据库服务硬编码凭据，以root执行任意系统命令。
items.affected: Cisco(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Cisco修复版本；限制Expressway数据库服务网络访问
items.repro_note: 网络访问Expressway数据库服务，使用硬编码凭据执行命令
items.impact_scope: 边界协作网关，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability in the database service feature of Cisco Expressway Series could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway device to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root on the underlying operating system of an affected device.

items.title: Pulsar Manager未授权凭据泄露
items.summary_zh: 未授权用户可借Pulsar Manager向任意主机发送集群凭据，进而操控Pulsar集群。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；限制管理端暴露并轮换集群凭据
items.repro_note: 未授权访问Pulsar Manager接口，诱导其向可控主机发送集群凭据
items.description: An unauthenticated user can therefore use Pulsar Manager to send requests to the Pulsar admin API, which the cluster processes with the credential configured in Pulsar Manager. An unauthenticated user can make Pulsar Manager send this credential to a host of the user's choosing, and the credential can then be used directly against the Pulsar cluster.

items.title: ATS magick插件参数注入
items.summary_zh: 未授权客户端可控ImageMagick convert参数，或致命令执行；需启用实验插件。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 启用magick插件后，向代理请求注入ImageMagick转换参数
items.description: Apache Traffic Server's experimental magick plugin lets an unauthenticated client control ImageMagick convert arguments in its default (unsigned) configuration. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 8.0.1 through 8.1.11, from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: ATS origin_auth签名越权
items.summary_zh: 客户端可迫使代理以自身凭据为攻击者指定AWS请求头签名，冒用云权限。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；禁用origin_server_auth插件
items.repro_note: 启用origin_server_auth插件，构造请求指定待签名AWS头
items.description: Apache Traffic Server's origin_server_auth plugin lets a client force signing of attacker-chosen AWS request headers under the proxy's own credentials. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 8.0.0 through 8.1.11, from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: ATS TLS会话复用证书错配
items.title_zh: ATS TLS会话复用证书错配
items.summary_zh: 默认出站会话复用可能让一笔事务沿用另一客户端证书，绕过证书隔离。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 配置出站session sharing及不同客户端证书，复现会话复用错配
items.impact_scope: 出站代理/网关，证书身份混淆
items.description: Apache Traffic Server's default outbound session-sharing policy can reuse a pooled TLS session authenticated with one client certificate for a transaction configured to present a different one. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: ATS SNI会话恢复绕过mTLS
items.summary_zh: 跨SNI虚拟主机恢复TLS会话时未重验客户端证书，可绕过STRICT策略。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 配置SNI多虚拟主机与verify_client STRICT，复用会话跨主机
items.description: Apache Traffic Server can resume a TLS session across SNI virtual hosts without re-verifying a client certificate required by the resumed host's verify_client STRICT policy. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 8.0.0 through 8.1.11, from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: Tenda BE3L Pro缓冲区溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向/goform/WifiBasicSet的security_5g参数触发缓冲区溢出，可能执行代码。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商补丁；限制管理接口访问并过滤security_5g参数
items.impact_scope: 家用/小型路由，管理面暴露风险
items.description: A flaw has been found in Tenda BE3L Pro 16.03.60.62. Affected by this vulnerability is the function formWifiBasicSet of the file /goform/WifiBasicSet. This manipulation of the argument security_5g causes buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: Cisco网络设备注入漏洞
items.summary_zh: Cisco多款网络设备存在注入类缺陷，可能被远程利用，具体入口未明。
items.affected: Cisco(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 跟踪Cisco修复公告并升级受影响产品
items.repro_note: 需确认受影响产品与接口，按公告复现注入路径
items.impact_scope: Cisco网络设备，受影响面待确认
items.description: This review resulted in software hardening releases that address multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities. The vulnerabilities tracked by CVE-2026-76473 are related to issues concerning improper control of a resource through its lifetime that are grouped under the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) Class CWE-74.

items.title: Cisco网络设备认证绕过
items.summary_zh: Cisco多款网络设备存在认证绕过，远程攻击者可能未授权访问，细节待公告。
items.affected: Cisco(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 跟踪并升级Cisco修复版本；临时收紧管理面访问
items.repro_note: 需确认受影响型号与入口，按公告验证认证绕过
items.description: This review resulted in software hardening releases that address multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities. The vulnerabilities tracked by CVE-2026-76474 are related to issues concerning improper authentication that are grouped under the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) Class CWE-287.

items.title: GStreamer堆溢出致代码执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可通过恶意媒体触发堆溢出，在当前进程执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；避免处理不可信媒体文件
items.repro_note: 构造恶意媒体流触发堆溢出，需目标解析该媒体
items.impact_scope: 多媒体处理库，广泛集成
items.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of GStreamer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
